definitions.gloss: used item; secondhand goods; pre-owned product
definitions.explanation: an item that has been previously owned or used; sold at a lower price than new items

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中古品|ちゅうこひん}です。
{中古品|ちゅうこひん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よければ→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}ない→問題ない：26594_mondainai⟧。
examples.english: Even a used item is fine if it's in good condition.

examples.japanese: {中古品|ちゅうこひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}ったら→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}んだ→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I bought a used item and it cost only half the price.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧ (used, secondhand) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item, goods)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{新品|しんぴん}→新品：08303_shinpin⟧ (brand new item) - opposite
- ⟦{中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}→中古車：25939_chuukosha⟧ (used car)
- ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧ (pre-owned apartment)
- ⟦リサイクル→リサイクル：04624_risaikuru⟧⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧ (secondhand shop)

USAGE:
⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧ alone can function as a no-adjective meaning "used" or "secondhand." Adding ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ emphasizes that it's a product or goods.

ALTERNATE READING:
The word ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧ is sometimes read as ちゅうぶる in certain dialects or older usage.
